overall_rationale: The must need N2 (mapping of product codes across the 2024 change) is unmet. The wiki product_codes_2024 states that no mapping table exists and codes can only be matched by non-unique product names, and no candidate supplies a pre-2024 code list. This makes the overall verdict not_feasible under the must-need rule. The other must needs are met with conditions: N1 daily sales (internal.sales.daily_by_product, access request, till gap treated as missing, product-level series cannot be stitched across 2024-04-01) and N3 daily max temperature (api.open_meteo_archive, which needs the commercial Open-Meteo plan and Legal approval).
